display: Bambu PA-CF (carbon-fibre nylon) — for the dual_pdm casing
notes: UNTESTED on this printer — stock profile as a starting point; expect tuning after the first print. Hard requirements: hardened nozzle (installed), filament MUST be dried before printing (PA is far more hygroscopic than PETG; wet PA-CF = foamy weak parts), and keep the door closed for chamber warmth. No 0.6 entry yet: verify the Orca profile name for 0.6 before adding. If the actual spool is another brand, make a separate file — do not reuse this one.
